subject: NewShore / AWS handshake: intro + proposed mutual action matrix
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@newshore.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NewShore / AWS handshake: intro + proposed mutual action matrix

Hi Sanjay / Megan —

Quick note from Redwood to jumpstart the AWS co-sell intro. AWS mentioned NewShore as a good fit for our joint solution (low-latency inference + secure VPC deployments) and suggested we get a short alignment call to map stakeholders and procurement steps.

We'd like to propose a 30-45 minute kickoff to:
- Align success criteria for a pilot (scope + KPIs)
- Identify AWS engagement model & co-sell owner
- Surface security / procurement must-haves early (SOC2, data residency)

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 11/17 10:00–10:45
- Wed 11/18 14:00–14:45
- Thu 11/19 09:00–09:45

I've attached a short one-pager on Redwood and a suggested Mutual Action (MA) matrix template as a starting point. Lauren will run the technical demo if we get to scheduling.

Can you confirm who from NewShore should join (procurement + data security)? Also looping in the AWS rep on cc so they can recommend the right co-sell path.

Thanks — looking forward to the intro.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198
redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf (1 page)

From: Megan Li <megan.li@newshore.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@newshore.io>, AWS Field Rep <aws-rep@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:06:00 -0500
Subject: Re: NewShore / AWS handshake: intro + proposed mutual action matrix

Thanks Connor — good to meet virtually.

We're excited to see how Redwood's inference runtime could help reduce inference cost for our forecasting product. For the kickoff we'll want:
- Technical lead: Megan Li (me) + Data Engineering: Sanjay
- Procurement/Legal: Priya D'Souza (cc later)
- Security reviewer: Tom Alvarez (info-sec)

Wed 11/18 14:00 PST works best for us (that's 17:00 EST). If AWS rep can join then great — otherwise AWS can provide guidance asynchronously.

I've attached our org chart and a short list of procurement milestones we typically require. Can you add an initial MA matrix with owners and target dates so we can see a timeline? Also curious about pilot pricing guidance and any SOC2 evidence you can share early.

Regards,
Megan Li
Head of Product + Partnerships, NewShore Analytics
megan.li@newshore.io | +1 312 555 0122

Attachments: newshore-org-chart.pdf, newshore-procurement-checklist.txt

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: NewShore / AWS handshake: intro + proposed mutual action matrix

Folks — forwarding NewShore's reply. Wed 11/18 14:00 PST is the caller preference.

Action items before the kickoff:
1) Lauren — can you draft a 20-min demo script focused on forecasting use case and expected latency/cost gains? Aim for a 15-min live demo + 5-min config discussion.
2) Jonas — can you prefill an MA matrix (owners + target dates) based on the procurement checklist attached by NewShore? Use conservative deadlines (2–3 week slotted cadence).
3) Kimberly — please pull SOC2 evidence and a short summary (what we can share) and call out any non-disclosure constraints.

I've pasted Megan's email below for context. I'll confirm the meeting once AWS rep confirms availability.

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 1:06 PM Megan Li <megan.li@newshore.io> wrote:
> Thanks Connor — good to meet virtually.
> 
> We're excited to see how Redwood's inference runtime could help reduce inference cost for our forecasting product...
> (attached: newshore-org-chart.pdf, newshore-procurement-checklist.txt)

Connor
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: NewShore / AWS handshake: intro + proposed mutual action matrix

Adding the draft MA matrix (attached) — I created a baseline with milestones, owners, and realistic target dates. Highlights:
- NDA / Data Processing Addendum: owner Kimberly; target 11/24
- Security questionnaire (initial answers): owner Kimberly; target 11/21
- Technical discovery & demo: owner Lauren; target 11/18 (kickoff)
- Pilot contract (30-day pilot): owner Connor/Legal; target sign by 12/08
- Pilot run & evaluation (30 days): owner NewShore Product; completion target 1/10
- Go/no-go and co-sell launch prep: owner AWS & Redwood; target 1/20

I've included a pilot pricing proposal row with two options: consumption-based and committed capacity. Jonas, please adjust SLA/throughput assumptions in column C based on our expected load from NewShore (they mentioned hourly forecasting batches).

Attachment: nsw-ma-matrix-v1.xlsx

Lauren
Product Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.ai

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@newshore.io>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@newshore.io>, AWS Field Rep <aws-rep@amazon.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Confirm: Wed 11/18 14:00 PST — NewShore x Redwood x AWS kickoff + MA matrix

Thanks, Megan — Wed 11/18 14:00 PST is confirmed on our side. Inviting a 45-minute block; invite to follow.

Next steps before the call:
- I've uploaded Lauren's MA draft and our one-pager here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MA-Matrix/NSW-v1
- Kimberly will attach a SOC2 summary to the calendar invite and prepare answers to NewShore's procurement checklist
- Megan / Sanjay — can you share the procurement contact (Priya D'Souza) and Tom Alvarez's email for security on the invite?

Agenda (45m):
1) Intros + success criteria (5m)
2) Technical demo (15m)
3) Pilot scope & telemetry (10m)
4) Procurement / security path (10m)
5) Next steps / owners (5m)

We'll also ask AWS to confirm the recommended co-sell program (Marketplace listing vs. direct co-sell) during the call so procurement knows the contracting runway.

See you Wed — Connor
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced in thread: redwood-onepager.pdf, newshore-org-chart.pdf, nsw-ma-matrix-v1.xlsx
